# WG23 · Phiếu thu · số thu vượt công nợ

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#receipts`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `finance.js › receipts()` form `#payment`: the amount is posted with an idempotency key (`paymentKey`); when it exceeds the open balance the server answers "Số thu vượt công nợ" and `command()` writes it into `#error`. The reach sets "Số thu" to 99999999 and presses "Xác nhận thu".
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"receipts\"]"} → {"setValue":["#payment [name=amount]","99999999"]} → {"click":"#payment .primary"}; it must show "Số thu vượt công nợ".

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Số thu vượt công nợ

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Số thu vượt công nợ"
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".

## Differences from the app design
- App H5 collects cash with one button per invoice (no amount field), so an over-payment cannot be typed there.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in H5/H6: "Số thu vượt công nợ"

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- The invoice select and the prefilled amount depend on the shared finance database: the snapshot masks them (`<varies>`).
- Canvas: boxed danger notice under the tabs; "Số thu" shows 99999999 as typed by the reach.

## Web canvas
- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WG23 · Phiếu thu · số thu vượt công nợ`.
- Canvas note: Web › finance › Phiếu thu & thông báo · nhập "Số thu" 99999999: máy chủ trả "Số thu vượt công nợ", hộp đỏ dưới các tab, không ghi phiếu; app H5 thu từng hóa đơn bằng một nút nên không gõ được số quá nợ · chưa có trên Next.js
